description.value: The Sicamous Branch of the Okanagan Regional Library serves this small community at the junction of the Trans-Canada and Hwy 97A in the Shuswap region. Part of a 30-branch network that ranks as the 16th largest library in Canada, this branch offers public computers, internet access, scanning to email, and a rotating art wall showcasing local artists. For touring cyclists passing through Sicamous, it provides a welcoming public space with connectivity and free on-site parking.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the branch address (446 Main Street) and phone number (250-836-4845), matching OSM. The website's Facilities & Services section lists computers and internet access, corroborating the OSM internet_access=wlan tag; Wi-Fi is treated as confirmed. No bike-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water refill) are mentioned anywhere in the website content, so those remain null.
concerns: None of the required cycling amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water) are mentioned on the website; a direct contact or site visit would be needed to confirm or deny these before listing.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is a legitimate, active public library with confirmed Wi-Fi and free parking, useful as a connectivity stop for touring cyclists. However, none of the three required WWC criteria (bike parking, washrooms, water refill) could be confirmed from the website, making it difficult to justify inclusion without a site visit or direct inquiry.
